scope: P4 public Browser Broker with real Chrome/CDP
claims: browser.public uses the existing Recruiting Executor class and immutable Recipe Browser Plan
each session uses a fresh Chrome process and temporary user-data directory
a POST attempted by page JavaScript is blocked by CDP before reaching the origin
popup and download attempts are prevented before their target navigation and produce a non-retryable effect-policy failure
cross-origin document redirects are stopped before reaching the target origin and robots disallow stops before page navigation
a missing wait selector is classified as a repairable parse failure rather than a transient browser transport failure
the public-site run verifies public addressing, robots policy, same-origin document navigation, bounded DOM capture, and effect attestation
DOM and attestation enter the existing Artifact, Listing, Detail, Discovery, and Failure contracts

verification.environment: Google Chrome with deterministic local origin and Recruiting extension unit contracts
Google Chrome, public network, read-only public website
Google Chrome with deterministic origins and repeated effect-policy fault injection
